impact.text: This flaw severely impairs the core functionality of FOK orders.

precondition_sources.text: The FOK order is submitted with amountIsBase set to true.
The user's FOK order amount is not a multiple of the market's lotSizeInBase.

intent_sources.text: FOK fill orders should not revert if only the amount rounded off is left unfilled.
Base-denominated FOK orders should only fail if available liquidity is less than the user's requested amount adjusted for the market's lot size.
